item.title: Shakeup at the CDC Prompts Deputy Director Ralph Abraham to Step Down
item.description: The CDC's deputy director announces his decision to step down from the agency after being sworn in just over two months prior to his resignation.

item.title: Popular Infant Formula Recalled Due to Cereulide Toxin Risk
item.description: Kendamil is recalling its infant formula after concerns arose about possible cereulide toxin contamination, which can be potentially deadly.

item.title: More Babies Will Be Born in These Two Continents in 2026 Than Anywhere Else
item.description: A calculation predicts that there will be a baby boom in 2026 with the largest number of babies being born to parents in Asia and Africa.

item.title: How Modern Water Solutions Supports Office Sustainability and Employee Well-Being
item.description: This article will look at the office sustainability crisis and how the hydration company FloWater is equipping employers and employees to address it

item.title: Urgent Recall Issued After Several People Were Burned While Using a Popular Pressure Cooker
item.description: The CPSC has issued a recall of the Gourmia Pressure Cooker after multiple people reported burn injuries while using the kitchen appliance.

item.title: Frozen Blueberries Are Being Recalled After the FDA Says They Could Be Contaminated With Listeria
item.description: The FDA is recalling frozen blueberries due to possible listeria contamination. The recall involves 55,000 pounds of berries sold in several states.

item.title: A Blood Moon Is Expected To Rise the Night of the Lunar Eclipse
item.description: There will be a total lunar eclipse the same night as a blood moon in 2026, and it will be visible to nearly 2.5 billion people in March.

item.title: Scouting American To Cave to Pete Hegseth’s Demands That the Program Stop DEI Practices
item.description: Pete Hegseth shared a video saying that he is requiring Scouting America to remove DEI initiative in order to continue government partnership.

item.title: Did You Have a Lot of Medical Expenses? Save Your Receipts Because They May Be Tax Deductible
item.description: Can you claim your medical expenses on your taxes? Understanding which medical bills you can claim and which one you can't is important when you file.

item.title: Research Finds Common Baby Formula Ingredient May Be Causing Liver Disease in Infants
item.description: A study conducted using pigs seems to have found a connection between a common ingredient used in baby formula and fatty liver disease.
